entries.label: centrifugal_pump
entries.description: Centrifugal pump (ISO 10628) — circle with a trapezoidal discharge spout; the standard rotodynamic pump glyph for flow-sheet drawings.

entries.label: positive_displacement_pump
entries.description: Positive displacement pump (ISO 10628) — rectangular body with chamber markings; covers reciprocating, gear and diaphragm pumps.

entries.label: compressor
entries.description: Compressor (ISO 10628) — trapezoid tapering toward the discharge; gas service, centrifugal or axial.

entries.label: reciprocating_compressor
entries.description: Reciprocating compressor (ISO 10628) — rectangle with piston/cylinder markings; positive-displacement gas compression.

entries.label: tank_vertical
entries.description: Vertical storage tank (ISO 10628) — tall cylinder with flat or dished roof; atmospheric or low-pressure bulk storage.

entries.label: tank_horizontal
entries.description: Horizontal storage tank (ISO 10628) — cylinder on its side with flat or dished ends; typical for LPG or liquid storage.

entries.label: vessel_vertical
entries.description: Vertical pressure vessel (ISO 10628) — cylinder with elliptical or hemispherical heads; knockout drum or reactor body.

entries.label: vessel_horizontal
entries.description: Horizontal pressure vessel (ISO 10628) — cylinder laid on its side with dished heads; two- or three-phase separator duty.

entries.label: distillation_column
entries.description: Distillation/fractionation column (ISO 10628) — tall vertical cylinder with horizontal lines indicating trays, or hatching indicating packing; multiple side nozzles.

entries.label: packed_column
entries.description: Packed column (ISO 10628) — vertical cylinder with diagonal hatching or a wavy fill denoting the packed bed region between support grids.

entries.label: shell_tube_heat_exchanger
entries.description: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger (ISO 10628) — horizontal cylinder with internal tube bundle; two shell-side and two tube-side nozzles.

entries.label: plate_heat_exchanger
entries.description: Plate heat exchanger (ISO 10628) — rectangular block with stacked parallel plate lines; compact liquid-liquid service.

entries.label: air_cooler
entries.description: Air-cooled heat exchanger (ISO 10628) — horizontal tube bank drawn as a rectangle with a circular fan glyph beneath; forced-draft or induced-draft.

entries.label: fired_heater
entries.description: Fired heater/furnace (ISO 10628) — rectangular firebox with burner triangles at the base and a stack on top; direct-fired process heating.

entries.label: cooling_tower
entries.description: Cooling tower (ISO 10628) — trapezoidal body widening upward with internal louver hatching and a fan glyph at the top; evaporative water cooling.

entries.label: cyclone_separator
entries.description: Cyclone separator (ISO 10628) — tall cylinder with a conical lower section, tangential inlet at the top and solids outlet at the cone apex.

entries.label: flare
entries.description: Flare (ISO 10628) — tall vertical stack with a flame triangle/icon at the tip; disposal of relief gases.

entries.label: filter
entries.description: Filter (ISO 10628) — rectangular or cylindrical body with an internal hatched strainer element; removes particulates from process fluid.

entries.label: gate_valve
entries.description: Gate valve (ISO 10628) — two opposed triangles meeting at a point (bowtie) with vertical stem; full-bore isolation.

entries.label: globe_valve
entries.description: Globe valve (ISO 10628) — bowtie with a solid disk at the junction; throttling duty.

entries.label: check_valve
entries.description: Check valve (ISO 10628) — bowtie with a swing or ball element drawn inside; one-way flow.

entries.label: control_valve
entries.description: Control valve (ISO 10628) — bowtie body with a diaphragm actuator dome on top; modulated by a flow/pressure/level loop.

entries.label: PI
entries.description: Pressure Indicator (ISO 10628) — local pressure gauge, circle with P + I; no transmission.

entries.label: TI
entries.description: Temperature Indicator (ISO 10628) — local temperature gauge, circle with T + I; no transmission.

entries.label: FI
entries.description: Flow Indicator (ISO 10628) — local flow gauge, circle with F + I.

entries.label: LI
entries.description: Level Indicator (ISO 10628) — local level gauge, circle with L + I; typically adjacent to a tank or vessel.

entries.label: transmitter_generic
entries.description: Generic transmitter (ISO 10628) — circle with two-letter tag ending in T (e.g. PT/TT/FT/LT); converts measurement to a remote signal.

notes: ISO 10628 starter set — v0. ISO 10628 is piping/equipment-focused, so coverage here skews heavily toward equipment glyphs (cooling tower, cyclone, flare, filter, packed column) and only carries the minimal local-indicator / transmitter instrument set. Instrumentation detail is expected to come from an extracted legend or the ISA-5.1 pack merged on top.
